description: Every Catapult GPS metric — ACWR, velocity benchmarks, load reports — from one command, with a local SQLite mirror for offline analysis.

novel_features.name: ACWR dashboard
novel_features.description: Instant acute:chronic workload ratios for any athlete or the full squad, color-coded into safe (0.8-1.3), caution, and danger (>1.5) zones.

novel_features.name: Weekly load report
novel_features.description: One-command weekly summary — total Player Load, session count, ACWR, max velocity vs PB, monotony, strain, and risk flags — exportable as markdown or CSV.

novel_features.name: Personal bests
novel_features.description: Compares recent session values against each athlete's all-time or rolling personal best, with readiness % and 3-session trend arrows.

novel_features.name: Session diff
novel_features.description: Side-by-side comparison of two sessions (by ID, date, or last/prev) showing absolute and percentage change per metric and per athlete.

novel_features.name: Positional benchmark
novel_features.description: Ranks any athlete against positional peers for a metric: percentile rank, squad median, and position median with outlier flags.

novel_features.name: Return-to-play tracker
novel_features.description: Tracks an injured athlete's load progression session-by-session as a percentage of squad average or a pre-injury baseline window.

novel_features.name: Period intensity heatmap
novel_features.description: Renders an athlete-by-period intensity matrix for a session — ANSI heatmap on a terminal, JSON matrix for agents — surfacing where fatigue compounded.

spec_source: internal-yaml: authored from the official SBGSports/catapultr R client source (R/ofCloud.R) — Catapult OpenField Cloud API v6; endpoints verified against live tenant
